title: Tomato and Olive Flan
description: A savoury baked flan filled with tomatoes, olives, basil, and Gruyère cheese.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 210°C. Brush a 20 cm deep flan tin with butter or oil and lightly flour the base and sides.
To make the pastry, place flour and butter in a food processor and process until the mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Add egg yolk and water and process until the dough just comes together.
Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll pastry to fit the prepared tin. Line with baking paper and fill with dried beans.
Bake for 15 minutes. Remove paper and beans and allow the pastry shell to cool slightly.
Mix olive oil and mustard to a smooth paste and spread evenly over the pastry base.
Heat butter in a pan and cook tomatoes and onions until soft. Drain off excess liquid.
Spoon the tomato mixture evenly over the pastry base.
Combine sugar, basil, and olives and scatter over the tomatoes.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the pastry is crisp and the cheese is golden.

notes.title: Olives
notes.content: Use good-quality olives such as Kalamata or Niçoise for best flavour.
